You don't need any cooldowns until the significant ability. And yeah, the defensive abilities are the only ones I use for that. Next cooldown on the special attacks. I usually use the damage reduction and healing abilities for the sword attack and use whatever cooldowns are left for the shield attack; with good damage output and favorable luck, the tank will have his ability downed and it will be a soft special attack. Again, no cooldown until the next significant ability. The second one is minor since there's no cleave after, using the defensive and healing abilities. For the next significant ability, big damage from the defensive ability and the other defensive ability. For the fourth one, the damage reduction should be back up; I use that and then the fight is nearly over, except you enrage but the boss just spams a powerful attack then and it's just a damage check from there. Hope it helped. Feel free to ask me anything that is unclear.

Also, there should be no third special attack; you won't meet the damage check if you get it. The boss should be around 71-69% at the significant ability. If you get him to 69, he will skip the cleave after the significant ability.
